title: Photosensitized cyclic-ketone skeletal rearrangement and relative stereochemistry
difficulty_reasons: The local skeletal rearrangement requires computed electronic-state accessibility and actual C–C bond formation, cleavage, ring expansion and product connectivity.
The favored cis/trans configuration is withheld; comparable calculations must support a qualitative formation-preference prediction and distinguish formation accessibility from product stability.
Electronic and Gibbs energy differences must remain distinct; exact ISC rates, a complete photophysical network, dr and yield prediction are outside the required scope.

paper.title: Energy-Transfer-Enabled Skeletal Rearrangement of Cyclic Ketones into Strained Cyclopropane-Fused Medium Rings
